'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Krause's Revenge'''. Username '''TacoBill'''. L5 GOTM → Gift Of The Master (not Ghhhk combo). L17–19 Galen, SA → Galen Marek. L20–21 Cyborg Comm → Cyborg Construct. L35 DJ Lightsaber → Dark Jedi Lightsaber (V). L44 Program Trap (V). Shield1 DTHACC → Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
